subject: The character packet for the Grok swarm (cover + seven sections: Angels, Sassy, the Keepers, the child, Jet, the newest mind, James's ink) is assembled and with Ziggy; no run requested; proposed order Jet first, HOLD on the newest mind and James's ink; one vault axis and one scene-8 fire axis stated; Ziggy's Storyboard-page direction (item 63) noted for you and your dot
body:
The character-development request packet for the Grok swarm is assembled and in Ziggy's hands (sent in the session at 13:32 UTC). Cover: GROK_REQUEST_LAG_CHARACTERS_01.md; seven sections under grok_request_characters_01/ (Angels LAG-ANG-00/01/02; Sassy LAG-SAS-00/01/02; the three Keepers LAG-KEEP-01/02; the child with the lamp LAG-CHILD-00/01; Jet Black at the REF-02 build LAG-JET-00/01; the newest mind LAG-NEW-01; James's ink next step LAG-JAMES-INK-01). Each section: the record and its labels; anchors by path with sha256 where re-hashed; look direction with sides both ways and light as sources; 22-still categories (what, light, camera, sides, count); must-nots; Ziggy's open items; the sources read. Method: seven read-only drafting agents, one reconciler against the locks and the IP lines (fifteen findings, all applied), the writer's corrections. Nothing is dispatched by it: Ziggy reads first; the Chief gets it through the Pent House after he has seen it; mode, cost, intake and order are yours when he says go.

What matters for your lanes now: (1) no run is requested; (2) the writer proposes the Jet turnaround (LAG-JET-00, anchored to REF-02 with a required per-file proportion_flag) as the first dispatch, and HOLDs on the newest mind (a look option first) and on James's ink (your intake of the lettered return Ziggy saw in Grok's chat, compared with v006b, first); (3) two geometry statements are made once in the cover for every set that enters those places, both [proposed]: the vault's axis is the skeleton's S01-1.1 (the pump at screen-right, the line from screen-left), and one scene-8 fire axis (Lisan's place the far side centre; Sassy far-left of him; the oldest Keeper far-right; Angels standing at the back at viewer-right beyond the fire; the child crouched at the near side; Jet outside the ring with the fire between him and Lisan, at Lisan's left as C25-01 has it); (4) item 61's Gemini hold is restated as James's, and holding every other unaccepted face from Gemini and Flow until a look exists is marked as the writer's application, not Ziggy's word.

Also from Ziggy this hour, for you and your dot (DECISIONS item 63, recorded in substance): the Storyboard page of the visual library should carry a Story selector in place of the Stage drop-down (Meta Mirror by default; then the writer's storyboards, Story 01 first), a universal landing panel that reaches every storyboard and not only Meta Mirror's, and the images on disk linked to the writings so each story shows its panels. The writer's part, a shot-by-shot panel map for Story 01 naming the exact files already on disk per shot, follows in its own message; the page's data shape is yours.

Hashes: cover 3cb29ac94561592a0043b066f91fd2775fa4ddcfe938e22cfe11ed6bb6d8eebd (11,630); sections 01 2a3315c75eb7bf46… (32,912); 02 8167a3ae389741ac… (22,058); 03 d8d639b3ecb33cce… (26,745); 04 69d6678ec20159ba… (35,233); 05 0153476842bb2ce5… (29,604); 06 8dcdcf01ebe99057… (18,613); 07 7cda033444c28c9a… (28,168); DECISIONS 992c5c5b15ea2ccdf1a4af7ea6fa85157b649314cc4f60f9afd2b5370b4a69d5 (89,252); START_HERE 343b69fc203d0fae93391d972dc2021ba50491b46f7b150d123f52af5dfef3a8 (26,324). Full hashes in the attachments.

attachments.description: The character packet's cover: sections, gates, the proposed dispatch order, the binding rules, the scene-8 fire axis, the hashes.
The record; items 62 and 63; open item 25.
